purpose: Independently judge the candidate against the original request, scoped check and affected contracts; report blockers without repairing.

execution.instructions: Read the full scoped Go execution receipt; missing selected tests, incomplete execution and skipped proof are not acceptance. Read the accepted plan/card manifest and verify every card acceptance condition against the original request, current combined patch and supplied full evidence. Internal card pins are unreviewed. Require complete structured request/seed/phase/work evidence for the investigation; report evidence_status alone is not proof of completeness. Missing sidecars or truncated stdout cannot prove the original failure resolved. Read the required before_measurements artifact retained from the first candidate measurement before correction, the latest measurements artifact, and the pristine baseline_measurements artifact. Independently compare complete pre-correction and post-correction request/seed/phase/work records for every authorized case. Preserve negative samples and distinguish changed seeds or environments from matched comparisons. The pristine baseline establishes only its original selected controls; absent case coverage and lost historical seeds cannot establish matched replay or prove the original timeout fixed. A failed baseline is failure evidence, never a successful timing claim. Require a supported cause and meaningful unchanged acceptance conditions. Independently review the original scoped Go request, retained patch, actual focused check and measurement evidence. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; read only affected source/contracts needed to judge completeness, correctness, public behavior, generated ownership, unnecessary work and meaningful test purpose/placement. Source is read-only. Do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Downstream packaging, runtime/browser qualification and protected release still must pass. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for a complete source handoff with sufficient supplied focused proof. A concrete in-scope repair returns changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing capability, infrastructure uncertainty or a required material decision returns blocked. Do not waive proof or widen scope. Keep findings and any missing proof in a summary of at most 240 characters. Measurements may be a runner-measure-history-v1 bundle. Parse its complete ordered entries programmatically and decode exact measurement JSON; select before/current by source, instrumentation, protocol, runtime and seeds, never round alone. Review intermediate profiled-before evidence as well as the latest experiment. The immutable before_measurements report and pristine baseline remain distinct; neither replaces matched instrumented evidence. The initial review may use retained checks of unchanged source; this is not fresh execution or qualification. No massive raw prompt dumps or timing/fix claims from incomparable reports.
